model: published benchmark arithmetic plus parameter sensitivity; not an AGASTYA process prediction

benchmark.citation: Saffarian, Galvin & Firouzi (2026), Minerals Engineering 242, 110189, DOI 10.1016/j.mineng.2026.110189
benchmark.feed: delaminated, crushed and ground EoL PV cells prepared for laboratory flotation

sensitivity.e_definition: fraction of feed silver ending in a separately accepted ECS silver-bearing product; unknown for AGASTYA
sensitivity.p_definition: fraction of feed silver routed into the flotation feed after ECS; unknown for AGASTYA
sensitivity.route_recovery_equation: R_total = e + p * r_f, assuming separate measured products with no double counting
sensitivity.break_even_equation: r_f_required = (0.9755 - e) / p, for p > 0; this compares algebraically with the direct flotation study benchmark
sensitivity.parameters_are: mathematical grid only; no values are asserted as likely or measured

limitations: The paper feed was prepared cell material; its recovery and upgrade are literature outcomes, not AGASTYA results or guarantees.
The derived mass pull is R/U from a paired study result and does not supply an AGASTYA feed grade or silver mass.
No direct matched-feed ECS versus flotation experiment, ECS silver partition, product acceptance, size partition, or route cost is available.
The simple sequence equation assumes a single accepted ECS silver-bearing product plus a non-overlapping flotation feed; actual stream definitions and assays are required.
The grid is a deterministic parameter sweep, not a probability distribution, equipment simulation, or forecast.
validation_needed: Measure total and silver mass in every classification/ECS/flotation stream on a homogenized representative feed; close mass and Ag balances with assay QA/QC, duplicate splits, residues and uncertainty.
